purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Kulim

queries.query: Kulim Malaysia official cadastral map parcel GIS land office
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Kulim District and Land Office, JUPEM eKadaster, the Kulim municipal KIDS GIS portal, and an official municipal ArcGIS parcel-finder service. The municipal parcel layer returned an anonymous parcel polygon at the exact WUP point.

queries.query: Kulim Kedah rasmi GIS kadaster peta lot tanah Pejabat Tanah
queries.result: First-party Malay-language discovery corroborated Pejabat Daerah dan Tanah Kulim, JUPEM Kedah/eKadaster, and the Majlis Perbandaran Kulim KIDS cadastral service. The public municipal parcel-finder endpoint was then queried anonymously with a bounded safe field allowlist.

registryEvidence: Kulim District and Land Office is the local land-administration custodian, while Majlis Perbandaran Kulim publishes the KIDS GIS service family. The municipal public parcel-finder layer is first-party municipal GIS evidence, not merely national-agency prose.

officialSources.observation: Official Kulim District and Land Office page identifies the local office and address in Kulim, Kedah.
Official Majlis Perbandaran Kulim ArcGIS REST folder lists Kulim/Kadastral_Kedah FeatureServer and MapServer services.
Public ArcGIS layer metadata identifies polygon layer Kadastral_Kulim_Proj, safe/native fields including OBJECTID and UPI, Web Mercator extent, and query capability.
Official JUPEM eKadaster login page; national cadastral context only, with no login attempted.

source: Majlis Perbandaran Kulim KIDS / MP_Kulim_Lot_Parcel_Finder_WFL1 public ArcGIS FeatureServer

requestOutcomes.outcome: TLS-verified response returned ArcGIS error code 499 Token Required. No token was requested or used; no fields or geometry were obtained from this protected route.

TLS-verified anonymous metadata response succeeded. Geometry type is esriGeometryPolygon; native fields include OBJECTID, NEGERI, DAERAH, MUKIM, SEKSYEN, LOT, UPI, KELUASAN, KEGUNAANTA, STATUS, and GUID; extent spatial reference is EPSG:3857/Web Mercator.

TLS-verified anonymous point-intersects query at the exact WUP point, inSR=4326, outSR=4326, returnGeometry=true, and safe outFields=OBJECTID,NEGERI,DAERAH,MUKIM,SEKSYEN,LOT,UPI,KELUASAN,KEGUNAANTA,STATUS,GUID returned one polygon. Native UPI was 0209400443820; full geometry was observed but not retained as a sample to avoid duplicating raw source attributes.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: EPSG:3857 layer extent; query response reprojected to EPSG:4326
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: Not needed for the observed sample: UPI is the source-provided canonical identity.

geometrySamples.retrieval: exact WUP point intersects one polygon; geometry observed, not retained

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Kulim municipal KIDS cadastral service and the MP_Kulim_Lot_Parcel_Finder_WFL1 public FeatureServer layer.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry is verified for the queried location and layer metadata is available; citywide completeness, update cadence, and service stability were not established.

remainingUncertainty: The exact-point sample proves a usable public parcel response at one location only, not citywide coverage or a production adapter contract. The protected Kadastral_Kedah route was not bypassed. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, unsafe owner/address/contact/titleholder/personal/tax/account fields, or TLS-disabling exception was used. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
